verdict.rationale: Bruno's first-party materials describe a privacy-first posture: offline-only with no plans for cloud sync, no account or login, 'zero visibility into your requests', and BYOK AI where no data is routed through Bruno servers. This implies little or no tracking by design, but none of it addresses product telemetry or usage analytics directly, and no opt-out control is documented. missing for 10: explicit statement on telemetry/usage analytics collection, documented opt-out setting or flag (GUI and CLI), independent verification of no phone-home behavior.
